punchline: Twenty-three paratroopers silenced four guns and found a map in the position.
thirty_sec: On the morning of 6 June 1944, Lieutenant Dick Winters led a small team of paratroopers, twenty-three by one count, against a German battery of four guns firing on Utah Beach. The guns were destroyed, four Americans were killed and two wounded, twenty Germans died, twelve were captured, and a map turned up.
question: Which small piece of your biggest current job could you finish this week, and what would you expect it to tell you about the next step?
key_contrast: A battery of sixty men, a team of twenty-three.
